meta.name: pi-goal
meta.description: Persistent Codex-style goal tracking for pi. Use when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, audit, pause, resume, complete, or inspect a long-running goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让助手持续跟踪长期目标，可随时查看和调整进度。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望让AI助手记住并持续推进你的长期目标。
copy.tagline_en: Keep your assistant on track with long-term goals, pause or resume anytime.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to remember and keep working on multi-step goals.

howto.what: 为长期目标提供持久追踪：能创建带预算的目标、查看当前目标，并在确认所有要求都完成后把目标标记为完成。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求设定、继续、检查长期目标，或已有进行中的目标时触发。

say.text: 帮我建一个目标：写完周报，预算2000 token。
say.note: Claude 会创建一条持久目标记录。

say.text: 查看我当前的目标进展。
say.note: Claude 会调取目标详情给你看。

say.text: 这个目标已完成，请标记完成。
say.note: Claude 会先核对实际状态再标记。

howto.what_en: Provides persistent tracking for long-running goals: can create a goal with a token budget, inspect the current goal, and mark it complete after verifying all requirements are met.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user explicitly asks to set, inspect, or complete a long-running goal, or when one is already active.

say_en.text: Create a goal to finish the weekly report with a 2000 token budget.
say_en.note: Claude creates a persistent goal record.

say_en.text: Show me the current goal progress.
say_en.note: Claude fetches and displays goal details.

say_en.text: This goal is done; mark it complete.
say_en.note: Claude verifies actual state before completing.
